title: OFT Mirror task views
hypothesis: Structured Mirror orthogonal task coordinates preserve task quality with fewer actual bytes than native OFT and beat byte-near simple orthogonal/low-rank controls.
mirror_coordinate: Task-specific product of eight adjacent-plane Givens rotations
controls: native OFT dense Cayley task transforms
shared map plus Mirror Givens Views
shared map plus exact matrix-free Mirror Givens View

paid_objects: dense native OFT effective task transforms
Mirror Givens angle codes sufficient for exact transform reconstruction

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=60% independent and >=10% better MSE than native OFT at byte-near cost (within 15%) or lower bytes.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/storage gate or OFT/simple control matches at equal/lower bytes.

amendments.reason: The initial serializer stored dense realized matrices for Mirror and block-orthogonal codes, so it overcharged a deterministically reconstructible Givens transform and made both controls functionally duplicate.
amendments.change: Mirror inference payload now stores exact learned Givens angles; transform is reconstructed matrix-free. Remove duplicate block_orthogonal arm. Native OFT stores its dense effective orthogonal matrix used for inference. Rerun development and actual-byte checks.
amendments.scope: No task, methods other than duplicate block control, quality metrics, seeds, updates, gates, or fresh seeds changed.
